test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Nov 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements about the river Brahmaputra is INCORRECT?

options.text: It flows eastwards parallel to the Himalayas.
Most of its courses lies outside India.
It enters India in Arunachal Pradesh where it is called the Dibang.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It enters India in Arunachal Pradesh where it is called the Dibang.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Brahmaputra originates under the name of Siang or Dihang, from the Chemayungdung glacier of the Kailash range near the **Mansarovar lake. Hence, statement 1 is Correct.**
 
• It enters** India west of Sadiya town in Arunachal Pradesh with the name Dihang. *Hence, statement 4 is Incorrect.***
 
• **Tributaries:**
 
 
• Dibang, Lohit, Siang, Burhi Dihing, Tista, and Dhansari.
 
 
 
• It is known as** Tsangpo in Tibet and Yarlung Zangbo in China.**
 
• The river crosses** Assam below Dhubri and enters Bangladesh where the river is known as Jamuna and it flows for 337 km.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Yarlung Tsangpo is the Tibetan name** for the upper course of Brahmaputra.
 
• Most of its course lies outside India.
 
• It flows through countries such as India, China, and Bangladesh.
 
• The Brahmaputra is also called the** "Red River".**
 
• The Brahmaputra is the Indian river that occupies the maximum volume of water.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83ec53be5948da6df4df6fc1ee05f096f4c9eaa4afaf694b601fa0ec1ccfde6d.png]
